name: Fujisaki Yuusuke
source: Yuusuke is a businessman that recently moved into the town of Toiro for work purposes. He eventually becomes a regular at the Osaki eel restaurant. Yuusuke has a refreshing personality, which alongside with his friendliness and polite charm, helps him leave excellent impressions upon everyone he meets. Even so, Yuusuke can be surprisingly argumentative. Quick-witted, he never loses in a verbal argument. As well as Atsunori, Moe also has a bad impression of Yuusuke; becoming much ruder than she usually is.
